newsitem.title: USA: Viking Office sees Q3 EPS up 15 percent.
newsitem.headline: Viking Office sees Q3 EPS up 15 percent.

text.p: Viking Office Products Inc said Tuesday that earnings per share for the third quarter ended March 31 are expected to be up about 15 percent over last year's third quarter, on consolidated revenues which also increased about 15 percent.
Net income after tax as a percentage of revenues is estimated at about 5.8 percent for the quarter, the company said.
Viking said revenues were affected by fewer billing days, slower growth in the United Kingdom and France, a stronger translated dollar, and paper pricing about 30 percent below last year.
It said Germany had record revenues for the quarter and was profitable, and revenue growth in Austria was ahead of plan in its first quarter of operation.

During the third quarter, United States revenue increased over last year by about 12 percent on a day-for-day basis, the company said. Due to one less billing day, U.S. revenue growth in the third quarter was 10 percent.
Viking said it would release its earnings on April 24.
